central_value_rule: the central value is EXACTLY kappa K + c2 K^2; any report whose central value differs from the bare two-term prediction has absorbed remainder and is rejected.
downstream_rule: ceiling/forecast propagation maps the full enclosure interval (never the central value alone) with components preserved; MES consumers receive the same separation as comparison-only rows.

reference_propagations.mes_consumer_note: comparison-only rows inherit the same component separation; nothing is promoted and no observational value is implied

uncertainty_components.inhouse_conservative_rule: M = 1 chosen above the envelope-sizing |c3| = |-94/875| (in-house margin, labeled)
uncertainty_components.physical_model_form: single-fluid fixed-w class assumption — UNQUANTIFIED_CONDITIONAL (never numeric zero)
uncertainty_components.source_convention: registered PR-125 convention channel; the legacy reproduction channel carries its own labeled delta and is never merged here

uncertainty_components.inhouse_conservative_rule: M = 1 chosen above the envelope-sizing |c3| = |-2/27| (in-house margin, labeled)
uncertainty_components.physical_model_form: single-fluid fixed-w class assumption — UNQUANTIFIED_CONDITIONAL (never numeric zero)

separation_rule: four typed components, never collapsed into a single number and never folded into the central value — numerical_enclosure (M |K|^3 remainder + engine enclosure widths), source_convention (registered PR-125 convention channel deltas, labeled), physical_model_form (single-fluid fixed-w class assumption, carried as UNQUANTIFIED_CONDITIONAL, never numeric zero), inhouse_conservative_rule (the margin between M and the envelope-sizing |c3|, labeled in-house choice).
